item.text: I’ll put the kebab in the “Current session” heading row, use the existing managed context-menu behavior for arrow-key navigation and Escape, and make option activation close the menu before starting the action. The bulk action will receive only IDs from the non-current-device map.

The reusable component is in place. I’m connecting it to the current-session heading and session actions now; I’ll also ensure the menu options themselves have menuitem semantics and close on both pointer and keyboard activation, with focus restored by the existing context-menu lifecycle.
The focused Jest run is still executing. I’ll use its result to catch integration issues, then run the TypeScript check if the tests pass.
